title: SafeKEEPER® Forensic Evidence Drying Cabinets
meta_title: SafeKEEPER Forensic Evidence Drying Cabinets - Secure Chain of Custody
meta_description: SafeKEEPER forensic evidence drying cabinets provide secure, controlled environments to dry and store forensic evidence while maintaining the chain of custody.
meta_keywords: forensic evidence, drying cabinet, chain of custody, secure storage, air science
short_description: SafeKEEPER® series forensic evidence drying cabinets are designed to store, dry or otherwise process forensic evidence in the controlled environment of a tamper-resistant compartment to maintain the chain of custody.
full_description:
SafeKEEPER® series forensic evidence drying cabinets provide cost-effective storage and containment for forensic evidence as it is dried by a constant flow of air. Air Science® ductless technology removes airborne pathogens, particulates, fumes and odors emitted by the contents. Using innovative filtration technology, the forensic evidence drying cabinet creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry, including:
  • State and Federal Crime Laboratories
  • Medical Examiners and Coroners
  • Law Enforcement Agencies
  • Hospital Emergency Rooms
  • Drug Agencies
seo_content: The SafeKEEPER forensic evidence drying cabinets feature programmable humidity control, HEPA/ULPA filtration, and tamper-resistant compartments to ensure the integrity of sensitive evidence throughout the drying process. Designed for use in a wide variety of forensic and law enforcement settings, these cabinets meet all relevant OSHA and ISO standards to provide a secure, compliant solution for maintaining the chain of custody.

Construction & Compliance.OSHA Compliance: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450
